title: Signature Duo 50 · Hourglass SSBBW × Hourglass SSBBW · Minakari × Celadon Kintsugi · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, two matching enormous hourglass figures.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — early 40s, sleek center-parted low bun with gold hairpins. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body. Body Art: Full body Persian minakari enamel painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A high-gloss cobalt blue enamel ground with dense turquoise, white, and red arabesques outlined in fine raised gold wire. The arabesques spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. No panels, no collar band. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — mid 40s, sleek high bun with gold pins. Hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — an overwhelmingly colossal bust, enormous round hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso and flaring far beyond the shoulders, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms, and a sharply cinched waist that stays clearly visible between them, with a soft rounded belly below the waistline that does not hide the waist. Huge, heavy, soft, unmistakably hourglass, not a plus-size model, not a shapeless round body. Body Art: Full body kintsugi painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. Pale celadon ceramic glaze with fine crackle and blazing raised gold repair seams. The gold seams spread wide across the colossal bust and hips and narrow across the cinched waistline. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing facing the camera in a relaxed contrapposto, her weight on one leg so that enormous hip juts far outward, the other heel lifted, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body. The right woman — standing full frontal in a wide stance, arms relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high turquoise enamel platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high platform stiletto mules in translucent iridescent pearl. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than their bodies, soft warm light from one side carving the deep inward curve of the waist and the huge curves of the bust and hips, making the gold wire glint on the left and making every gold seam glow on the right, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
